label: prop:q-beta-spectral-bridge
title: $\mathfrak{Q}_\beta$ spectral bridge: Form A (NF counit) and Form B (transfer-matrix log-ratio) are the same observable in different bases
html:
Proposition (conditional on Borromean quark conjecture — \mathfrak{Q}_\beta spectral bridge).

Let \mathcal{B}_n be the canonical free-neutron braid word with single wrap A = 1. Let q = q_0 be the substrate parameter and h := q - q^{-1}. We define the Markov–Jones parameter as:

  z \;:=\; \frac{q^{3}}{q^{2}+1} \;=\; \frac{q^{2}}{[2]_q}.

Write E_0 := m_e/(q(q-1)) for the single-tick energy scale. Let:

  \mathfrak{Q}_\beta^{\mathrm{A}} \;:=\;
  \lvert \Delta(\mathrm{net}) \rvert \cdot E_0
  \qquad
  \mathfrak{Q}_\beta^{\mathrm{B}} \;:=\;
  \ln\!\frac{V_{\mathrm{pp}}}{V_{\mathrm{nn}}} \cdot \frac{E_0}{z}

denote the closed-form Q-value in the normal form counit basis and the transfer-matrix eigenfunction basis, respectively. Both forms are finite-depth truncations of the same spectral decomposition. They agree as:

  \frac{\mathfrak{Q}_\beta^{\mathrm{A}}}{\mathfrak{Q}_\beta^{\mathrm{B}}}
  \;=\;
  1 \;+\; \frac{(z-1)\,h}{2} \;+\; O(h^2),

with bridge identity:

  \mathfrak{Q}_\beta^{\mathrm{A}}
  \;=\;
  \ln\!\frac{V_{\mathrm{pp}}}{V_{\mathrm{nn}}} \cdot \frac{E_0}{z}
  \cdot \Bigl(1 + \tfrac{(z-1)\,h}{2} + O(h^2)\Bigr).

The remainder at depth N in the brane-tower truncation decays exponentially.

Migrated C → D, 2026-09-05 (qou-i229 → qou-cds1, owner-approved: "refresh and migrate"). The definition above read z := 1/(\sqrt q + 1/\sqrt q) = 0.4993\ldots — convention C of the trace-convention registry, marked there EXCISED 2026-08-09 (reconciliation). It is now z = q^3/(q^2+1) = 0.6127\ldots, convention D, which the registry records as this channel's definitional convention per the owner ruling of 2026-08-15 ("convention D is convention. excise convention C"), with C structurally excluded — in D the loop values satisfy z\,z_- = 1/[2]_q^2 and the framing ratio is the monomial a = q^2, while C admits no such factorisation.

The table was migrated from the producer, not by hand. Every value in the data table now comes from q-beta-spectral-bridge.witness.json, which has computed q^3/(q^2+1) all along — the divergence measured here on 2026-09-05 was 21 % between a C-frame table and a D-frame producer, with both witness assertions passing because a producer checking itself against itself cannot see that it has drifted from the block it names.

The anchor moved too, and that is also executed rather than decided. The table was on muon pin A; the producer is on the proton pin, migrated 2026-08-29 under qou-cds3 with the authorisation recorded there — AGENTS.md §"q₀ anchor convention", "we want proton unless for an explicit reason … fix all, even if not visible". So both axes were already ruled and the block simply had not followed.

What moved. \mathfrak{Q}_\beta^{\mathrm{A}} is essentially unchanged at 0.7836 MeV, but \mathfrak{Q}_\beta^{\mathrm{B}} moves 0.8324 \to 0.8234 MeV and the A/B disagreement improves from 0.0487 to 0.0398 MeV against the same h^2 E_0 = 0.183 MeV bound. The bridge ratio moves 1.898 \to 1.566, which is the 1/z term following the convention.
